subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different user/model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The source and user reports establish the need for an append primitive, but the permanent model-facing tool contract and backend operation shape are maintainer-owned API/product decisions.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a separate append tool
options.body: Ask the PR to split append into a separate model-facing tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a narrower replacement
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if a narrower replacement proves the same behavior with stronger proof and a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land once current-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history signal for the agent runtime/tool API boundary and product contract decision.
